author: Vik_the_Thracian
body: What you're looking for is a skeleton mob carrying an orange bag. I can confirm that they spawn in day time and night time. Then you'll have to kill a zombie carrying an orange bag and generally keep killing different mobs with orange bags (witches, mummies, vampires and ghosts) to get all the drops. If you're not T10 the questline ends there.
